info.name: Workday Security Workday Audit and Compliance Account Signons Audit Logs API
Workday Security List audit log entries

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description: Start of the date range for filtering audit log entries

params.name: toDateTime
params.description: End of the date range for filtering audit log entries

params.name: eventType
params.description: Filter by the type of audit event

params.name: actor
params.description: Filter by the account that performed the audited action

params.name: target
params.description: Filter by the target resource or object of the audited action

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of audit log entries for the tenant. Audit logs record system events, configuration changes, data modifications, and administrative actions. Supports filtering by date range, event type, and the actor who performed the action.

info.name: Workday Security Get a specific audit log entry

params.name: auditLogId
params.description: Unique identifier of the audit log entry

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific audit log entry including the full event context, before and after values for configuration changes, and related audit entries.
